title: Codebase AI
description: Queries any public GitHub repository in natural language and returns cited, source-grounded answers. Retrieval is a hybrid of cosine similarity and AST-based Python symbol lookup. No RAG framework was used and every retrieval change was validated with a controlled A/B evaluation across 100+ live runs before being kept.

title: B-Tree Database
description: A disk-backed key-value store written in C from scratch, with no external libraries. Stores a B-tree index across fixed 4KB pages so the dataset can grow beyond memory, and uses a write-ahead log so a crash mid-write leaves the database intact.

title: MNIST Neural Network
description: Neural Network that classifies handwritten digits, trained on the MNIST dataset (70,000 28×28 greyscale images). It was built from scratch with forward propagation, backpropagation and gradient descent, before I wrote the AI backend for Codebase AI. Reaches 97.2% accuracy on the 10,000-image test set.

title: Mosque Prayer Times Device
description: A Raspberry Pi Zero 2W device that calculates daily prayer times for Newcastle and plays the Adhan through a speaker system over Bluetooth. It runs unattended as a systemd service with PulseAudio audio routing and uses a keepalive to stop the speaker connection dropping. I fixed a boot-order race where the service started before Bluetooth was ready by making it wait for the Bluetooth stack.
